Classify genes as S-phase progression markers

Source: R/progression_markers.R
classify_progression_markers.Rd

Adds BH-adjusted fdr (non-finite p-values count as 1), the AIC difference delta_aic_null_minus_gam and the flags aic_pass, expression_pass (expressed_fraction >= min_cell_fraction), dynamic (fdr < fdr_threshold and aic_pass) and marker (dynamic and expression_pass).

Usage

classify_progression_markers(
  fit_table,
  group_name,
  n_cells,
  min_cell_fraction = 0.2,
  fdr_threshold = 0.01,
  aic_rule = c("gam_lower", "paper_literal_gam_greater")
)

Arguments

fit_table

Output of fit_gene_gams().

group_name, n_cells

Group label and cell number, stored in the analysis_group and n_cells columns.

min_cell_fraction

Minimum fraction of cells expressing the gene.

fdr_threshold

FDR cut-off for the smooth term.

aic_rule

"gam_lower": the GAM must have the lower AIC; "paper_literal_gam_greater": the opposite.

Value

fit_table with the added columns, gene, analysis_group, n_cells first, sorted by fdr then decreasing AIC difference.
